## JDK modules

Modules the application and its libraries need at runtime, from `jdeps --print-module-deps` (followed transitively from the application classes). The list is reduced: jlink adds the modules these require, for example `java.sql` for `java.sql.rowset`. Use it to build a custom runtime:

```
jlink --add-modules java.base,java.compiler,java.desktop,java.instrument,java.net.http,java.prefs,java.rmi,java.scripting,java.security.jgss,java.sql.rowset,jdk.jfr,jdk.management,jdk.net,jdk.unsupported --output runtime
```
